2608.23138.title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
2608.23138.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. Pointing and OFG show complementary strengths across native and cross-dataset evaluations. The OFG/contact readout transfers to NORA-1.5, preserving or improving success while reducing recorded controller time by more than 20$\times$; typed heads are also 6.68--6.90$\times$ faster than Embodied-R1 text decoding on a shared external suite. When integrated as spatial guidance for a $π_{0.5}$ action policy, Pointing-VLA raises autonomous real-robot success from 52.7\% to 80.7\% across three visual contexts. These results establish typed spatial readouts as an efficient, inspectable interface between embodied reasoning and robot execution.
2608.23138.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型通常通過自回歸文本坐標或不透明的行動標記來揭示空間基礎，從而在多模態推理和機器人執行之間創造脆弱的接口。<lb/>我們提出了 Pointing-VLA，一種基於 Embodied-R1 的類型隱藏狀態空間讀出。<lb/>幾何特定的頭部預測標準化點、物體功能基礎 (OFG) 熱圖和視覺軌跡，而不將幾何序列化為文本。<lb/>對於評估的 Bridge/WidowX 和實體拾取-放置部署，明確的執行合同將 PICK 指派給源條件的 OFG，並將 PLACE 指派給 Pointing，提供直接的舞台對齊空間目標。<lb/>Pointing-VLA 在 Bridge/WidowX 上達到 SOTA 性能，在評估的四任務集上平均達到 72.9\%，而無需在碰撞啟用的 CuRobo 執行下進行 Bridge 特定的微調。<lb/>Pointing 和 OFG 在本地和跨數據集評估中顯示出互補的優勢。<lb/>OFG/contact 讀出可轉移至 NORA-1.5，保持或提高成功率，同時將記錄的控制器時間減少超過 20$\times$；類型頭部的速度也比 Embodied-R1 文本解碼快 6.68--6.90$\times$，在共享的外部套件上。<lb/>當作為 $π_{0.5}$ 行動策略的空間指導整合時，Pointing-VLA 將自主真實機器人的成功率從 52.7\% 提高到 80.7\%，涵蓋三個視覺上下文。<lb/>這些結果確立了類型空間讀出作為一種高效、可檢查的接口，連接具身推理和機器人執行。
